poses.caption: Sit supported with overhand machine handles at shoulder height and elbows bent
Press both handles overhead, keeping elbows soft and back supported

jobs.detail: LEVER SHOULDER PRESS. FRONT three-quarter view. Seated upright with back/pelvis against upright BACKREST, feet flat floor shoulder width, ribs down, no trunk arch or leg drive. BOTH hands hold HORIZONTAL handles OVERHAND palms forward/down, thumbs wrapped. LEFT start handles SHOULDER level, wrists neutral above elbows, both elbows bent90degrees. RIGHT extend both arms UP overhead, elbows almost straight but SOFT not locked, hands above respective shoulders, upper arms close to ears. Shoulder elevation is natural but no neck tilt. SAME simple two independent rigid steel pressing arms rotate around SAME fixed rear/upper pivots, each handle remains connected, SAME lever lengths, frame, backrest, stack, base between phases. Do not add/remove beams or change pivot locations; only pressing arms rotate and resistance stack lifts. Both deltoid shoulder caps RED only, triceps/forearms/chest grayscale, entire shirt and shorts BLACK opaque. Whole overhead handles, fingers, head, shoes and complete machine fit comfortably inside each panel.

poses.caption: Sit with chest supported and overhand T-bar handles forward, arms extended
Row handles toward torso while keeping chest against pad and feet supported

jobs.detail: LEVER T BAR ROW in SEATED chest-supported leverage machine arrangement specified by canonical record. Rear-side three-quarter view shows upper back, chest pad support and BOTH horizontal handles. Sit on seat with chest firmly against inclined front pad, feet flat on footplate, knees comfortably bent, neutral spine and neck. Hands hold horizontal T-shaped handle crossbar slightly wider than shoulders with OVERHAND PRONATED palms DOWN grip, thumbs wrapped. LEFT arms extend FORWARD/down around chest pad with softly unlocked elbows. RIGHT pull same T-handle toward lower chest/upper abdomen, elbows bend and travel BACK outside torso, shoulder blades squeeze; chest stays ON pad, no torso lift or shrug. Same simple central rigid T lever has fixed pivot on FRONT low frame, SAME length and connected horizontal crossbar both phases; rotates toward chest while weight stack rises. No disconnected handle, changing lever lengths, extra joints or moving fixed frame. Entire frame/seat/footplate/stack/pivots inside each panel. Primary UPPER MID BACK only soft DIFFUSE RED tint printed over intact BLACK shirt between shoulder blades, no red fiber bundles or anatomical subdivisions on fabric. Exposed arms/shoulders/legs grayscale.
jobs.prompt: Edit ONLY black shirt highlight in BOTH panels of this original project T-bar row illustration. No internal lines or anatomical sections within red patch. Keep entire shirt wrapping torso front/sides/back, shorts wrapping seat/crotch/upper thighs. Preserve exposed fine grayscale anatomical fibers on limbs, pose, face, hands, equipment, camera, dimensions and two-panel layout. Do not change exercise or machinery during clothing correction. White background, no text.
